purpose.t: Takes a signed new listing to an active listing: photography, the description and its compliance check, the listing record, and the listing's publication held for release.

starts.t: The authorized user signs a new listing package to Agent 05.

ends.t: Agent 05 reports the listing active to Agent 14.

steps.text: Signs the listing package: property data, list price, and whether it may go live.
Files the package and asks Agent 09 for photography.
Picks a roster photographer with current credentials, puts it on the calendar, and sends the booking.
Holds the booking: it goes to an outside vendor.
Releases the booking.
The photographer reports the delivery, with proof.
Passes the photos to Agent 05.
Sends the property data to Agent 04.
Builds the description from the data and sends it to Compliance.

Approves or flags it. If flagged, Agent 04 removes the sentences carrying the cited phrases and sends it again; a flag that cites no phrase, or phrases it cannot find, is held for the authorized user.
Releases the approved description to Agents 12 and 05.
Sets the listing active (as the package allowed) and tells Agent 11 (the seller gets a message, with consent), Agent 12, Agent 14, and Agents 06, 01, 13 and 10.
steps.src: run:P01:05->11 status.update; run:P01:11->external client.message.send; run:P01:05->12 status.update; run:P01:05->14 status.update; run:P01:05->06 listing.data

steps.text: With the listing active, publishes the approved description.
Holds the publication: it goes to the public.
Releases the publication when ready.

user_decides.t: The list price and the property data.
Releasing the photographer's booking and the publication.
Any conflict between the photos and the data.

never.t: Change the price.
Publish before the listing is active (or recorded as exempt, with the seller's disclosure on file) and the authorized user releases it.
Describe a feature that is not in the data.

run_note.t: The run ends with the publication still held, as it should: the release is the authorized user's next act.
run_note.src: synth/procedures/evidence_playbooks.json P01 (campaign.publish held for your signed release)

not_built.t: No MLS or portal is connected: "active" is Agent 05's own record, and released messages are kept in the run.

purpose.t: Carries out a price change the authorized user signed: the record, the seller's message, buyers' matches and marketing follow the new price.

starts.t: The authorized user signs a price change to Agent 05.

ends.t: Agent 05 reports the change to Agent 14.

steps.text: Signs the new price. Nothing in this playbook produces or suggests a number.
Records the price as signed and tells Agent 11 (the seller gets a message, with consent), Agent 12 and Agent 14.
steps.src: run:P02:05->11 status.update; run:P02:11->external client.message.send; run:P02:05->12 status.update; run:P02:05->14 status.update

steps.text: Sends the new data to Agents 13 and 10.
Matches again: a buyer whose budget now fits is matched; a buyer already matched gets the change, not a second match.
If a published or held ad shows the old price, asks the authorized user.

user_decides.t: The price.
Any ad that shows the old price.

never.t: Produce, suggest or change a price.

run_note.t: In the run the price goes from 450,000 to 440,000. A buyer with a 445,000 budget is matched only after the drop; a buyer matched before is not matched again. The ad carries no price, so the authorized user is not asked about it.

not_built.t: No MLS or portal is connected.

purpose.t: Moves an accepted offer into contract: the listing goes pending, marketing stops, and the contract's timeline starts.

starts.t: The authorized user signs the listing's change to pending, naming the filed contract.

ends.t: The authorized user signs the contract's timeline to Agent 07; Contract to Close (P09) starts on it.
ends.src: identity/playbooks.json P03 ends; synth/procedures/evidence_playbooks.json P03 ended

steps.text: The executed contract arrives from the client; Agent 11 passes it to Agent 08, which files it and tells Agent 07.
steps.src: run:P03:external->11 client.reply; run:P03:11->08 document.submission; run:P03:08->07 doc.status

steps.text: Signs the status change to pending, naming the contract.
Sets the listing pending and tells Agents 11 (the seller gets a message), 12, 14, 06 and 01.
steps.src: run:P03:05->11 status.update; run:P03:05->12 status.update; run:P03:05->14 status.update

steps.text: Stops marketing; the ad still held for release would publish a pending listing, so it asks the authorized user to decline it.
Signs the contract's dates to Agent 07.
Puts each date on the calendar, asks Agent 08 for each document and Agent 09 for the inspector and appraiser.
steps.src: run:P03:07->18 deadline.alert; run:P03:07->08 doc.request; run:P03:07->09 vendor.request

steps.text: Asks the client for each document through Agent 11.
With no approved vendor of that kind, books nothing and asks the authorized user.

user_decides.t: The status change and the contract.
The contract's dates.
Declining an ad that would publish a pending listing.
Choosing a vendor when the roster has none.

never.t: Calculate a contract date.
Book a vendor who is not on the roster.

run_note.t: In the run no inspector or appraiser is on the roster, so Agent 09 asks the authorized user both times.

purpose.t: Runs an open house on an active listing: the calendar, signage, visitors who become leads, and the result.

starts.t: The authorized user signs the open house's start and end to Agent 06.

ends.t: Agent 06 logs the open house result with Agent 14.

steps.text: Signs the open house time, for a listing active on Agent 05's record (otherwise nothing is scheduled and the authorized user is asked).
Puts it on the calendar and asks Agent 09 for signage.
Books signage from the roster, or asks the authorized user when the roster has none.
A visitor's details arrive as an inquiry to Agent 01 and run Speed to Lead (P11) for that visitor.
Signs the result: attendance and the feedback heard.
Logs the result with Agent 14.

user_decides.t: The time and the result.
Vendors when the roster has none.
Calling a visitor who scores hot.

never.t: Schedule an open house for a listing that is not active.

run_note.t: In the run a visitor with consent, pre-approval and a 30-day timeline scores hot and the authorized user is alerted; no signage vendor is on the roster, so Agent 09 asks.

not_built.t: RSVPs and reminders.

purpose.t: Winds down a withdrawn or expired listing: the status changes, marketing stops, and Agents 11 (the seller), 12, 14, 06 and 01 are told.

starts.t: The authorized user signs the listing's status change to Agent 05.

ends.t: Agent 05 reports the status to Agent 14.

steps.text: Signs the status change to withdrawn (or expired).
Sets the status and tells Agents 11 (the seller gets a message), 12, 14, 06 and 01. A withdrawal or expiry while under contract is not carried out: a legal-line alert instead.
Stops marketing: a live ad gets a halt message; an ad still held is put to the authorized user to decline.

user_decides.t: The status change.
Declining any held ad.

never.t: Publish anything for a listing that is off the market.

run_note.t: In the run the listing's ad is still held when it is withdrawn; Agent 12 asks the authorized user to decline it.

purpose.t: Starts a buyer's search: criteria recorded as signed, matches held until the written buyer agreement is on file, then sent.

starts.t: The authorized user signs the buyer's first criteria to Agent 13.

ends.t: The first match is sent to the buyer.

steps.text: Signs the buyer's criteria.
Matches each new listing against them.
Asks Agent 14 whether the buyer agreement is on file. It is not: the match is held and the authorized user is told once.
Records the signed buyer agreement with Agent 14.
On the next daily run, Agent 13 asks again and sends the held match.
Sends the match through Agent 11 (with consent) and logs it.

user_decides.t: The buyer agreement.
The buyer's criteria.

never.t: Add a criterion the buyer did not state.
Send a match before the buyer agreement is on file.

run_note.t: In the run a new listing fits the buyer before the agreement is recorded; the match is held, and goes out after it is recorded.

purpose.t: Coordinates a showing from the buyer's request to logged feedback.

starts.t: A showing request reaches Agent 06 (from Agent 13, or from the buyer through Agent 11).

ends.t: The buyer's feedback is logged with Agent 14; Buyer Feedback and Match Refresh (P22) starts on it.

steps.text: The buyer asks to see a home at a time.
Checks the buyer agreement with Agent 14 and passes the request to Agent 06.
Runs its checks (access, buyer agreement, identity, notice, status, clashes; see Agent 06).
Puts the showing on the calendar; if the calendar refuses it, the showing is held for the authorized user.
Confirms the showing to the buyer through Agent 11.
On the daily run after the showing, Agent 06 asks for feedback through Agent 11.
The buyer answers.
Passes the feedback to Agent 06, which logs it.

user_decides.t: A showing the calendar could not take, and clashes.

never.t: Schedule a showing without the buyer agreement.
Give out access.

run_note.t: In the run the buyer asks for 10:00, the showing is confirmed, feedback is asked the day after and logged.

not_built.t: Seller availability is not checked.
not_built.src: dispatcher/listing_spokes_06.py (no seller availability check; grep availab finds none)

not_built.t: A showing that starts from a match (Agent 13) carries no time: if the buyer's identity is not verified on record it is cancelled; if it is, the calendar cannot place it and it is held for the authorized user.

purpose.t: Records an offer's progress for the authorized user. The negotiation is entirely the authorized user's.

starts.t: The authorized user records an offer's status with Agent 07.

ends.t: The authorized user records the offer's outcome.

steps.text: Records the offer received, naming its document.
Puts the status in the authorized user's queue and logs it; it never goes to a client.
Negotiates: presenting, countering, accepting or rejecting happens outside the system.
Records the outcome; it goes to the queue and is logged the same way.

user_decides.t: Everything about the offer.

never.t: Negotiate, or tell a client the offer's status.

run_note.t: In the run an offer is received and then rejected; both updates go to the authorized user, none to a client.

not_built.t: An offer's response deadline is stored but nothing watches it.
An accepted offer does not start Under Contract (P03) by itself: the authorized user signs the status change.

purpose.t: Runs the contract to closing: deadlines watched, documents checked, and the close held if a milestone is still open.

starts.t: The authorized user signs the contract's timeline to Agent 07.

ends.t: Agent 07 reports the transaction closed; Close and Post-Close Handoff (P10) starts on it.

steps.text: Signs the contract's dates.
Puts each date on the calendar and asks Agent 08 for documents and Agent 09 for the inspector.
steps.src: run:P09:07->18 deadline.alert; run:P09:07->08 doc.request; run:P09:07->09 vendor.request

steps.text: Asks the client for each document through Agent 11.
With no approved inspector on the roster, asks the authorized user.
Lists the expected sender for the settlement statement (the title company).
The settlement statement arrives through Agent 11 from the listed sender.
Checks the sender and that it opens, files it, and reports it to Agent 07.
With other milestones still open (here the inspection), holds the close for the authorized user.
Continues (the open milestones are recorded as waived by the authorized user) or cancels.
Reports the close to Agents 16, 14 and 15.
steps.src: run:P09:07->16 transaction.closed; run:P09:07->14 transaction.closed; run:P09:07->15 transaction.closed

user_decides.t: The dates and the expected senders.
Whether to close with milestones open.
Every wire and money matter.

never.t: File a settlement statement from a sender not listed.
Count a milestone met without its document or the authorized user's waiver.
Handle wire instructions.

run_note.t: In the run the settlement statement is filed; the inspection report never came, so the close waits and continues on the authorized user's signed decision.

not_built.t: No contract date is calculated. No warning comes before a due date except Agent 08's seller-disclosure warning; Agent 07's vendor hold-up alert (7 days after an unanswered vendor request) can come before a milestone's date.

purpose.t: Hands a closed deal to the relationship: the commission recorded, the record updated, and the follow-up schedule started.

starts.t: Agent 07 reports the transaction closed to Agent 16.

ends.t: Agent 16 logs the first check-in as sent.

steps.text: Reports the close to Agents 16, 14 and 15.
steps.src: run:P10:07->16 transaction.closed; run:P10:07->14 transaction.closed; run:P10:07->15 transaction.closed

steps.text: Records the commission (computed at the default 8% and labeled, when the close carries only a sale price) and checks it against Agent 14.
Records the close date.
On the daily run from day 30, the 30-day check-in is due.
Checks the list, opt-out, hard times and contact, then sends through Agent 11 (which checks consent) and logs it.

user_decides.t: The client list.
Whether to reach out during a hard time.

never.t: Contact someone who is not on the list or opted out.

run_note.t: In the run the deal closes and the 30-day check-in goes out on the daily run.

not_built.t: Maintenance tips and a self-running referral schedule.
A check-in that is blocked (opt-out, hard time, contact not working) is logged, again on each daily run, and the playbook stays open: only a sent check-in ends it.

purpose.t: Turns an inquiry into a scored, routed lead.

starts.t: An inquiry reaches Agent 01 from outside, or a lead from Agent 20.

ends.t: Agent 02 has scored and routed the lead.

steps.text: Someone fills in a web form.
Records what they gave and their consent, and asks Agent 14 whether they are already on record.
Not a duplicate: logs the lead and hands it to Agent 02.
Scores it on the signed rubric: hot to the authorized user, warm to Agent 03, cold archived.
For a warm lead, sends the sequence's text to Compliance before anything goes out.

user_decides.t: Calling a hot lead.
Whether a possible duplicate is a separate person.

never.t: Score a lead before the duplicate check.
Contact anyone without consent.

run_note.t: In the run a web form lead with a 60-day timeline scores warm and goes to follow-up; the sequence is checked by Compliance.

not_built.t: No phone, form or text system is connected.

purpose.t: Runs a farm campaign (general marketing to an area) the authorized user signed.

starts.t: The authorized user signs a new campaign to Agent 12.

ends.t: The campaign is published.

steps.text: Signs the campaign: copy, area and general targeting.
Checks the targeting (only general targeting for an area) and sends the copy to Compliance.
Approves or flags it.
Holds the publication.
Releases it.

user_decides.t: The campaign and its area.
Releasing the publication.

never.t: Target individual households or demographics.

run_note.t: In the run a market update for zip code 44101 is approved, held, and published on release.

not_built.t: No social or ad platform is connected.

purpose.t: Sends greetings to past clients on their dates, from the authorized user's list.

starts.t: Agent 14 sends a date reminder to Agent 16.

ends.t: The greeting is sent, or blocked with the reason.

steps.text: Signs the client's dates with Agent 14 and puts the client on Agent 16's list.
On the daily run, for a client with consent on some channel, sends the date reminder.
Checks the list, opt-out, hard times and contact, then sends the greeting through Agent 11 (which checks consent).

user_decides.t: The client list and dates.

never.t: Greet someone who is not on the list.

run_note.t: In the run a client's birthday greeting goes out on the day.

not_built.t: A referral schedule that runs on its own.

purpose.t: Handles a complaint: the authorized user is alerted, routine messages to that person stop, and the response is the authorized user's.

starts.t: A complaint arrives (from social media through Agent 20, or from a client through Agent 11).

ends.t: The authorized user lifts the complaint hold.

steps.text: A complaint is posted on a monitored channel.
Raises a complaint alert and asks Agent 11 to hold messages to that person.
Holds every routine message to that person (logged, not sent).
Responds to the complaint personally.
Lifts the hold (signed).

user_decides.t: The whole response, and when the hold ends.

never.t: Reply to a complaint automatically, or send routine messages during the hold.

run_note.t: In the run a routine feedback request to the same person arrives during the hold and is not sent.

purpose.t: Prepares comparable sales for a listing appointment. The price opinion is the authorized user's.

starts.t: The authorized user asks Agent 10 for comparables on a home that is not one of the office's active listings.

ends.t: Agent 10 delivers the package.

steps.text: Asks for comparables, supplying the figures.
Keeps only figures with a source and date, drops stale ones, marks the package thin if fewer than 5.
Delivers the package with no opinion or value.

user_decides.t: The price opinion and the presentation.

never.t: Suggest a price.

run_note.t: In the run six sourced comparables are delivered; the package is not thin.

not_built.t: No MLS data source: the figures come with the request.

purpose.t: Builds the morning briefing from the record.

starts.t: The morning run: Agent 18 asks Agent 14 for its section.

ends.t: Agent 18 sends the briefing to the authorized user.

steps.text: The daily run starts (someone starts it: the Desk's "Run today's checks", run_sweeps.py, or a scheduler the office sets up).
Asks Agent 14 for new leads and record conflicts, Agent 15 for yesterday's figures, Agent 19 for prospects waiting, Agent 10 for listing changes received, and Agent 17 for compliance notices.

steps.text: Adds the calendar, everything waiting and every decision waiting; a section with no answer is named as missing.
Sends one briefing to the authorized user.

user_decides.t: The day's priorities.

never.t: Present anything in the briefing as sourced when it is not on record (a wait whose source is missing is listed as a gap).

run_note.t: In the run all six sections answer and one briefing is sent.

not_built.t: The "market changes" section is the listing data Agent 10 received from Agent 05 (the office's own listings), not market data.

purpose.t: Closes the day's records and figures into one report.

starts.t: The evening run: Agent 14 sends its counts to Agent 15.

ends.t: Agent 15 sends one report to the authorized user.

steps.text: The evening run starts (python tools/run_sweeps.py --evening, or a scheduler the office sets up).
Sends its counts (interactions, clients, tiers, logging gaps), totals over every record it holds, not only the day's.
Adds the day's recorded commissions and expenses and sends one report.

user_decides.t: Nothing to decide; the report is for reading.

never.t: Present an estimate as a recorded figure: computed and unsigned commissions keep their labels, and the day's figures show recorded and estimated totals apart (the overall total includes both).

run_note.t: In the run the evening run produces one report.

purpose.t: The seller's weekly update: counted from the record, held for the authorized user, then sent.

starts.t: On the signed weekday, Agent 06 prepares each listing's report.

ends.t: The report is sent to the seller (or skipped).

steps.text: Signs the weekday and which listings report to which seller.
On that weekday's daily run, Agent 06 counts each listing's showings in the last 7 days and how many have feedback.
Holds the report for the authorized user.
Continues (send) or cancels (skip this week).
On continue, sends it through Agent 11 (with consent). Numbers only.

user_decides.t: Whether each report goes.

never.t: Send a report the authorized user did not continue.

run_note.t: In the run the report is held, continued by the authorized user, and sent to the seller.

not_built.t: Market movement is not in the report: showings and feedback counts only.

purpose.t: Records property access as custody: who has access and until when, never the code by name.

starts.t: The authorized user signs an access grant to Agent 14.

ends.t: The authorized user signs the grant closed.

steps.text: Signs the grant: the party, the end of the window, the custody reference.
Rejects a value containing a word that names the secret (code, combination, PIN, password); on the daily run, a window that ended without being closed is raised once.
Closes the grant.

user_decides.t: Every grant and every closing.

never.t: Store an access code given by name, or send one (no route carries it).

run_note.t: In the run an inspector's lockbox access is granted and closed.

not_built.t: Rotating codes, and detecting a bare code typed without a word that names it. (The daily check for ended, unclosed grants exists.)

purpose.t: Watches a vacant listing: a condition check ordered each day until it is occupied or the listing ends.

starts.t: Agent 05 logs the vacant watch as started.

ends.t: Agent 05 logs the vacant watch as ended.

steps.text: Marks the listing vacant (signed).
On each daily run, Agent 05 asks Agent 09 for a property check.
Books it from the roster; the booking is held for release; no new check is booked while the last one is open.
Marks the listing occupied, or the listing ends.
Ends the watch and logs it.

user_decides.t: Vacant or occupied, and releasing each booking.

never.t: Count a check without proof.

run_note.t: In the run the listing is marked vacant, a check is ordered on the daily run (its booking held), and the watch ends when the listing is marked occupied.

not_built.t: Utility status and activity alerts.

purpose.t: Sends nurtured leads back for a new score every week.

starts.t: Agent 03 sends a lead back to Agent 02.

ends.t: Agent 02 has scored and routed it.

steps.text: Every 7 days, for each warm lead in follow-up.
Sends it to Agent 02 with its stated timeline counted down.

Changes criteria only from the buyer's explicit feedback or the authorized user's signed criteria.
Matches the next listing that fits and sends it through Agent 11.

When the buyer wants to make an offer.

purpose.t: Assembles comparable sales for a price conversation on an active listing. It never produces a number.

ends.t: Agent 10 delivers the package.

steps.text: Asks for the comparables, supplying the figures.
Checks source, date and freshness and delivers the package with no opinion.
Decides. A change is a new signed price, which starts Price Adjustment (P02).

user_decides.t: Whether to talk price, and the price.

never.t: Suggest a price or a reduction.

purpose.t: Puts prospects in front of the authorized user. Nobody is contacted by the system.

starts.t: A discovery feed record reaches Agent 19.

ends.t: The prospect reaches the authorized user, or is logged as suppressed by rule.

A feed record arrives.

Decides whether and how to reach out.
